title: Tenma Tsukasa — Training With A Buddy!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Tenma Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huff! Huff! Huff!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Huh? He was here a second ago...
Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I'm over here!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa, what the?!
Why are you face down on the floor like that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Can't you tell? I'm doing push-ups!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Umm... Push-ups? For what?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait a second!
Did you actually sign up to compete in Shinobi Battle?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! As I mentioned, with Kiritani and Akito!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I knew it! That explains why you've been training so hard!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good luck, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I promise to rush over so that I can cheer you guys on if I have time after my meeting!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thanks, Saki!
But it's a very important meeting for work, no? You should be focusing all your attention on that.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know!
I am a pro now after all!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, Saki, are you free right now?
I'd like for you to add some extra weight by pressing down on my back a little.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sure, but how hard?
I probably shouldn't sit on your back, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, try pressing down using your hands.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Umm... How's this?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Ah, that's perfect!
I'll get started now!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmph! Hmph! Hmph!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, you're so cool!
You're doing great, Tsukasa!
The next day
Kamiyama High School - Class 3-C

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Interesting. Shinonome's one thing, but Haruka Kiritani? You managed to put together quite a team for this event.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes, and I can't thank her enough.
I put her in a difficult position, knowing that she's an idol.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So, have you already decided who is going to be doing what? I'm particularly interested in the water spider obstacle.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That's a part of the second stage, which we've assigned to Akito.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Ah, Shinonome.
He seems like the right choice, with his core strength and sense of balance.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Still, it's interesting how they decided to go with such an old-fashioned interpretation of the “water spider” device.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Old-fashioned? Didn't ninjas use those special shoes to walk across the water, just like the obstacle?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Ah, so you haven't heard that one theory.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Theory...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The common interpretation is that ninjas used “water spider” floats to move just like water striders, yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But one theory suggests that they didn't attach the floats to their feet at all.
Interesting, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
Where did they put the floats, if not on their feet?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
On their bodies.
Either by wearing something like an inner tube, or by sitting on a plank of wood in the center.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Slow down.
Doesn't that mean submerging half your body?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, the theory I read spoke of propelling yourself using your feet, while only your upper body remained above the surface.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Th-That's quite a revelation...
I honestly had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Originally, people claimed that it would've been physically impossible for the traditional water spider to provide enough buoyancy to cross the water while standing.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If anything, it only makes sense someone arrived on a more practical conclusion.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, it isn't wrong to believe that they also used these floats on their feet.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: For example, when crossing a swamp, they could have been used to disperse your weight in order to keep your feet from sinking.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have a feeling that they were used in different ways depending on the situation.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I see...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I wasn't expecting to hear a theory that completely overturned my understanding of this subject! Again, I honestly had no idea!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, there was a brief period when this theory was on everyone's minds, but it faded into the annals of history not long after, without much impact at all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Perhaps it didn't find much purchase because, like you just said, Tsukasa... people didn't want their understanding of water spiders, or rather, their beliefs regarding ninjas to be shattered.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To keep that dream alive.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A ninja running across the water like a real water spider is much cooler than the theory, no?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, true...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It may be physically impossible, but it's easy to think that perhaps ninjas could have still managed it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, Miku and the others have been working very hard to become ninjas after you told them that you'd be competing in Shinobi Battle.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'll actually be taking over some things that will allow them to experience being water spiders.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Like the ones they had back then?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, not exactly.
Mine are going to be simple imitations that use modern materials.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Still, that's incredible!
When will they be done?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have to order quite a lot of things, so even if I did put a rush on them, I probably won't finish making them until after Shinobi Battle.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Which is a shame, since your team could've used them to practice...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Not a problem.
Our training will more than make up for that!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But I'd like to try what you make once you're done with them!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, of course.
